finding: The 2026-09-30 prospective feature snapshot was computed before the 2026-09-29 Core13 historical bars were actually inserted into production market_bars. The frozen row-position feature engine therefore silently skipped the required 2026-09-29 trading session.

root_cause.behavior: rolling features use the last N existing database rows without an expected-previous-session continuity gate

cross_source_proof.ffd_20260929_vs_recovered_longbridge: 13/13 OHLC exact; 13/13 amount exact; 13/13 volume unit mapping exact
cross_source_proof.production_reproduction: Removing 2026-09-29 from FFD history reproduces the immutable production 2026-09-30 price-derived features, amount ratio and realized volatility; including it materially changes the frozen features.
cross_source_proof.provider_native_continuity_check: 2026-09-30 quote.prev_close mismatches the then-latest 2026-09-28 database close for 13/13 symbols and matches the recovered 2026-09-29 close for 13/13 symbols. 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09 pass the same prior-close identity check 13/13.

next_fix_design.future_ingest_gate: Before inserting the current daily bar, compare manifest quote.normalized.prev_close with the latest prior Longbridge daily-bar close for every Core13 symbol; missing prior bar, missing prev_close, or any mismatch fails closed before feature computation.
